electrons.name: electrons
electrons.definition: [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 1], muons = [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 2]

jets.name: jets
jets.definition: [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 4]

bjets.name: bjets
bjets.definition: [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 4 and int(o['btag']) == 1]

met.name: met
met.definition: [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 6]

lepton.name: lepton
lepton.definition: [e for e in electrons if e['pt'] > 25 and abs(e['eta']) < 2.5] + [m for m in muons if m['pt'] > 25 and abs(m['eta']) < 2.4], met = [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 6]

light_jets.name: light_jets
light_jets.definition: [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 4 and int(o['btag']) == 0]

bjet1.name: bjet1
bjet1.definition: [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5], w_hadronic = sum_objects(light_jets_sorted[0], light_jets_sorted[1])

bjet2.name: bjet2
bjet2.definition: [b for b in bjets if b['pt'] > 30 and abs(b['eta']) < 2.5]
